title: Microsoft Purview: proactive AI insights from Data Security Investigations in DSPM exfiltration reports
summary: The opt-in workflow, daily analysis, metered billing and listed controls are supported by Microsoft documentation. Remove the unsupported assurance that no new identity is involved, and clarify the conflicting Microsoft guidance about investigation access and additional categorisation.
